raw: van de Ven M. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' The linesman raises his flag. Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) is adjudged offside.
90+5' Liverpool work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+5' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
90+4' Liverpool are seeing far more of the ball now.
90+2' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) is penalised for holding. Samuel Barrott signals a set piece.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Total attempts – 9:24.
88' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

87' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Alisson leaps like a salmon to deny him.
87' Arne Slot has decided to make a change. Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) replaces Mohamed Salah.
87' It will be a substitution. Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is ready to enter the pitch as Luis Diaz walks off.

85' 3 - 6 GOAL! Superb work from Mohamed Salah, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Luis Diaz (Liverpool), who beats Fraser Forster with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 3:6.
84' Some great play by Luis Diaz (Liverpool) ends with a shot on the edge of the box low towards the middle of the net, but Fraser Forster sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
83' 3 - 5 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Brennan Johnson and Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 3:5.
82' Substitution. Heung-Min Son is replaced by Timo Werner (Tottenham).
81' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
80' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
79' What was Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
78' Samuel Barrott blows for a foul after Diogo Jota (Liverpool) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
78' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 7:20.
76' Unlucky! A great strike from Luis Diaz (Liverpool) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
75' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) takes the corner but it's cleared.

72' 2 - 5 Goal! Dominic Solanke shows great vision to find Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the left side of the goal. 2:5.
71' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) brings his opponent down. Samuel Barrott has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
70' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
68' Arne Slot has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Curtis Jones (Liverpool) replacing Alexis Mac Allister.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Diogo Jota (Liverpool) is coming onto the pitch as Cody Gakpo cannot continue after picking up an injury.
67' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) took the corner.
67' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) inside the box.
67' A cross into the box from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is cleared.
66' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) will deliver the corner kick.
65' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
64' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) gets inside the box and tries to beat Fraser Forster with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
64' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool).

63' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the left side of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
62' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Samuel Barrott no option but to blow his whistle.

61' 1 - 5 It's a goal! Dominik Szoboszlai plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Mohamed Salah (Liverpool). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 1:5.
59' Tottenham take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
58' Ange Postecoglou has decided to substitute James Maddison and he is replaced by Brennan Johnson (Tottenham).
58' Pape Matar Sarr goes off the pitch and Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) comes on.
57' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) spurns a great opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. The ball flies narrowly wide of the left post.
54' 1 - 4 Goal! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 1:4.
54' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
54' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
52' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
49' Dangerous play by Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool). Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul.
48' A cross by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
46' Referee Samuel Barrott blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' 1 - 3 Goal - 1:3! Mohamed Salah laid the ball off to Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool), who shot from close range low into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
43' Flag goes up against Luis Diaz (Liverpool) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

41' 1 - 2 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by James Maddison (Tottenham) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the right side of the net.
41' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Alisson.
39' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
38' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
36' 0 - 2 Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) finds some space inside the box and scores with a terrific header into the top right corner, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
35' James Maddison (Tottenham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
33' The total number of attempts is 2:10.
31' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
31' The game is interrupted as Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) is flagged offside.
30' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
29' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Andrew Robertson (Liverpool), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
28' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul after James Maddison (Tottenham) hacks down one of his opponents.
26' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Fraser Forster makes a comfortable save.
24' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies well wide of the left post.
24' Tottenham take a short corner kick.
23' 0 - 1 Goal! Trent Alexander-Arnold is the provider and Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is the executioner, dispatching the cross into the right of the goal from close in with his head. 0:1.
20' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
20' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes the corner which is cleared.
18' Crossbar! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range crashed against the crossbar.
17' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
17' Wow, what an escape. Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
16' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
15' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
14' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
13' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Samuel Barrott saw the whole situation.
11' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
10' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.

10' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards low towards the middle of the goal, but Fraser Forster is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
9' James Maddison (Tottenham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
7' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) tackles a bit over-zealously and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul.
6' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
6' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
4' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post.
3' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the right post.
1' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) heads on.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Tottenham will have the kick-off.
Samuel Barrott got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
